question: In the POP-Q (Pelvic Organ Prolapse Quantification) system, Stage III prolapse means the leading edge of prolapse is more than 1 cm beyond the hymen but not completely everted.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. In the POP-Q system: Stage 0 = no prolapse; Stage I = leading edge > -1 cm from hymen; Stage II = leading edge between -1 and +1 cm; Stage III = leading edge > +1 cm but not complete eversion; Stage IV = complete eversion.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. POP-Q Stage III is defined as prolapse with the leading point >+1 cm beyond the hymen (i.e., beyond the plane of the hymen by more than 1 cm) but not the maximum possible descent (Stage IV = complete eversion).
